% Section 7 — Discussion and Conclusion (compressed)
% Full discussion paragraphs moved to Appendix C.

OntoCoDec compiles IE ontology schemas into composable token-level decoding constraints, achieving 42--99\% DR reduction across three models and two datasets with no significant F1 cost.
Composed with LoRA fine-tuning, it reaches DR\,$\leq$\,0.20\% at $<$0.6\,pp F1 cost, confirming near-lossless composability.
Within calibrated models (Qwen, Llama; $n{=}4$), residual DR correlates linearly with $\bar{\kappa} \times \text{RV}_{\text{baseline}}$ ($R^2{=}0.99$), suggesting constraint benefit scales with schema stringency and model OOV tendency.
This pattern has an informative boundary condition: Mistral achieves RV\,=\,0\% on SciERC yet retains DR\,=\,13.4\%, because its dominant error mode is entity type misclassification rather than vocabulary confusion, a factor not captured by the dual-factor product.
We present this as a descriptive characterization with explicit scope rather than a universal predictive law.

Constraint effectiveness is insensitive to prompt variation: across three prompt styles, DR reduction remains 94.0--94.6\% with $\sigma{=}$0.3\,pp (Appendix~\ref{app:prompt-sensitivity}), confirming that the mechanism operates independently of prompt content.

CF impact is model-dependent: S1 introduces CF for well-calibrated models (up to 12.02\%) but reduces it for poorly-calibrated ones (Mistral: 56.87\%\,$\to$\,1.27\%).
Ablation confirms CF$\leftrightarrow$DR tension ($+$13.85\,pp; Appendix~\ref{app:cf-dr-tradeoff}); fine-tuning reduces CF by 88\% (\S\ref{sec:composability}); global entity-level type consensus offers the most direct path forward.

Beam search ($k{=}4$) offers a complementary path: on SciERC (551 documents), it eliminates DR entirely (0.93\%$\to$0\%) while reducing CF from 9.90\% to 0.53\%, simultaneously resolving the two main limitations of greedy decoding.
For calibrated models (Qwen, Llama), beam search achieves DR=0\% on both datasets.
We recommend greedy decoding for latency-sensitive deployment and beam search when constraint satisfaction is paramount (full results in Appendix~\ref{app:beam-search}).
For calibrated models, beam search ($k{\geq}4$) eliminates all residual DR violations across both datasets, suggesting that grammar-first fallback events are search failures rather than fundamental constraint limitations.

Prompt-level intervention (schema-informed prompting) reduces violations by ~62% but cannot eliminate them — certain relation types retain 25-30% violation rates even with explicit constraint descriptions. OntoCoDec provides **near-complete elimination (DR 15.4%→0.93%, ↓94%) at zero or positive F1 impact** through automatic ontology-to-decoder constraint compilation with two complementary layers.\\n\\n**Phase 2 confirmed (D012 bootstrap CI, v2 fix)**: Grammar+Semantic dual-layer constrained decoding reduces domain/range violations by 94%, eliminates entity-type and relation-vocabulary violations entirely (→0%). F1 impact is **dataset-dependent**:\\n- SciERC: Rel F1 neutral (+0.13pp, p=0.58), Ent F1 neutral (-0.03pp, p=0.53)\\n- DocRED: Rel F1 **significantly improved** (+0.50pp, p<0.001, 95% CI [+0.23, +0.81]); Ent F1 **significantly improved** (+1.23pp, p<0.001, 95% CI [+0.94, +1.55])\\n- Mechanism: grammar 消除 OOV relation names (DocRED RV 29.66%→0.03%) + 非标 entity types (ET 2.48%→0%)。all_set F1 方法下 OOV=FP → fewer FP → higher precision/F1。SciERC baseline RV/ET 已很低，效果不显著。\\n- **Grammar 层是 F1 提升的唯一来源**: grammar_only Ent F1=59.38% ≈ full_s1 59.37% (Δ+0.01pp, p=0.66)。Semantic 层对 F1 无额外贡献，专注 DR reduction。\\n\\n## Core Claims\\n\\n### Claim 1 (Empirical): Violation Landscape\\nLLM-based IE systems violate ontology type constraints at non-trivial rates (15.4% per-triple on SciERC, 18.7% on DocRED). Violations are **not uniformly distributed** — they concentrate on relation types with tight domain/range constraints (Feature-of 33.5%, Compare 42.4%) while loose-constraint relations show near-zero violation (Used-for 0.8%).\\n\\n**Key insight**: Violation rate is driven by **constraint tightness**, not ontology size. A small ontology with tight constraints can produce more violations than a large ontology with loose constraints.\\n\\n**D014 修订**: DR reduction ceiling 由 **tightness × model RV baseline** 共同决定，非 tightness 单因素。Llama DocRED DR↓90.2% vs Qwen DR↓44.7%（同一 ontology τ̄=0.842）。机制：Qwen RV=29.66% >> Llama RV=16.03% → grammar 层将 OOV triples 强制匹配有效关系名 → 揭露大量 latent DR violations → 残余 DR 更高。这是比单一 tightness 更深的 insight。\\n\\n**Evidence**: SciERC (7 relations) 15.4%; DocRED (96 relations) 18.7% — comparable rates despite 14× ontology size difference. Schema-informed prompt on DocRED only achieves DR↓32% (vs SciERC ↓62%), confirming **prompt-level intervention scales poorly with ontology complexity**.\\n\\n### Claim 2 (Empirical): Prompt Insufficiency\\nSchema-informed prompting (explicitly describing domain/range constraints in the prompt) reduces but does not eliminate violations:\\n- Overall: 15.4% → 5.78% (-62.4%), still above 5%\\n- Per-relation: Compare 42.4% → 27.6%, Evaluate-for 24.1% → 29.9% (**worse**)\\n- Prompt intervention is unreliable at the per-relation level — some relations improve, one regresses\\n\\n**Narrative**: This is NOT about \\\"5.78% barely above 5%\\\". The story is: **prompt-level intervention is fundamentally unreliable as a guarantee mechanism**. It works statistically but cannot provide per-instance compliance. Three specific relation types retain >10% violation rates with schema-informed prompts. For safety-critical IE (biomedical, legal, regulatory), statistical reduction is insufficient — guaranteed compliance is required.\\n\\n### Claim 3 (Methodological): Composable Constraint Framework\\nOntoCoDec automatically compiles IE ontology schemas into two composable constraint layers:\\n1. **Grammar layer** (XGrammar): JSON structure + type vocabulary constraints (CFG-expressible)\\n2. **Semantic layer** (TypeConstraintProcessor): Cross-field domain/range constraints via stateful entity registry + dynamic logit masking\\n\\nThe two layers are **complementary with enabling dependency**: grammar ensures every generated relation type is in the valid vocabulary, which enables the semantic layer to look up and enforce domain/range rules for that type. Without grammar, the semantic layer encounters unknown relation types and cannot enforce constraints (explaining why semantic_only achieves only ↓24% vs full_s1 ↓94%). This is NOT \\\"synergistic\\\" (mutual amplification) — grammar is a prerequisite for semantic, not vice versa.\\n\\nThe two layers compose via bitwise AND of token masks. Recommended framing: \\\"Grammar and semantic constraints compose via bitwise AND with an enabling dependency: grammar ensures structural validity, enabling semantic constraints to enforce domain/range rules. When constraint tightness creates empty intersection between layers, the system degrades gracefully to grammar-only constraints, maintaining structural validity as a guaranteed floor.\\\"\\n\\n**Graceful degradation + Fallback 频率量化** (D008 + Reviewer 发现):\\nWhen $M_{semantic} \\\\cap M_{grammar} = \\\\emptyset$, the system falls back to grammar-only control.\\n\\n**关键量化数据（Reviewer 从日志挖掘）**:\\n- Llama DocRED full_s1: **32,921 次 fallback / 577 docs = ~57 次/doc**\\n- Llama SciERC full_s1: **5,882 次 fallback / 550 docs = ~10.7 次/doc**\\n- DocRED fallback 频率是 SciERC 的 **5.3×**\\n- Qwen DocRED fallback 率未知（日志当时无 fallback logging，需估算）\\n\\n**这直接解释了 DocRED DR 残余 10.19% vs SciERC 0.93%**: 更多 token 位置退化为 grammar-only → grammar-only 的 DR 已知为 26.17% → 高 fallback = 高残余 DR。\\n\\n**论文建议**: 在 §5 tightness 段报告 fallback 率，定义 \\\"Constraint Coverage\\\" 指标（semantic masking 实际生效的 token 比例）。这把 \\\"10.19% DR 残余\\\" 从弱点变成可量化分析的 finding。Frame as \\\"engineering robustness\\\" in §4; fallback 频率 + tightness 作为 §5 定量分析。\\n\\n**Decidability taxonomy**: Constraints classified by prefix-decidability:\\n- (a) Purely local: entity type ∈ vocabulary (grammar layer)\\n- (b) Prefix-decidable with state: relation argument types compatible with domain/range (semantic layer, requires entity registry)\\n- (c) Truly non-local: forward coreference — out of scope for forward-only decoding\\n\\n### Claim 4 (Methodological): S1 vs S2 Decoding Strategies — Architectural Ablation\\n- S1 (single-pass): Both layers applied throughout generation. **Recommended primary strategy** — simpler, slightly better metrics across the board.\\n- S2 (two-pass): Pass 1 extracts entities (grammar-only), Pass 2 generates relations with input-dependent grammar compiled from Pass 1 entities.\\n\\n**S2 full results (551/551 SciERC)**: DR 0.97% (vs S1 0.93%), CF 8.03% (vs S1 9.9%), R-F1 8.03% (vs S1 8.36%). S2 does NOT solve CF — the 1.87pp reduction is not significant. S2 also slightly worse on DR and F1. **S2 is an architectural variant demonstrating framework flexibility, not a CF solution.** Position in paper as ablation (Section 5 or Appendix), not as a core contribution.\\n\\n⚠️ **Do NOT cite pilot50 DR=0% as S2 evidence** — small-sample artifact; full run shows DR=0.97%. Per-relation S2 DR is worse than S1 on Compare (4.6% vs 2.82%), Part-of (1.25% vs 0%), Used-for (0.12% vs 0%).\\n\\n### Claim 5 (Empirical): Cross-Task Generalization — Event Extraction (D040, NEW)\\n**Status**: 🔄 In progress (Agent implementing WikiEvents pipeline)\\n\\nOntoCoDec generalizes beyond Relation Extraction to **Event Extraction** (WikiEvents, Li et al. NAACL 2021), demonstrating that the framework is task-agnostic for any IE task with ontology-defined type constraints.\\n\\n**WikiEvents specifics** (DARPA KAIROS ontology):\\n- 51 event types × 80 argument roles × 26 entity types\\n- 226 组显式 (event_type, role) → allowed_entity_types 约束，从 `event_role_KAIROS.json` 的 `role_types` 字段直接获取\\n- Maps directly to OntoCoDec's semantic layer: argument role type constraints ≡ domain/range constraints\\n- 26 entity types（比 ACE05 的 7 个更丰富）→ constraint space 更大，更能展示 semantic layer 价值\\n- 99.98% 数据满足约束 → 约束定义是真实有效的\\n\\n**数据集选择理由**（MAVEN/RAMS 排除）：\\n- MAVEN (168 types): 无 argument extraction，不适用\\n- MAVEN-Arg (162 types): FrameNet-based，无 role→entity_type schema 约束\\n- RAMS (139 types): 仅 cardinality 约束，无 entity type binding\\n- ACE05 (33 types): LDC 付费，采购周期来不及\\n- **WikiEvents 是唯一同时满足 \\\"免费 + 有显式 role→entity_type 约束\\\" 的数据集**\\n\\n**Violation 分类** (5 类，从 RE 的 4 类扩展):\\n- ET (Entity Type): entity type 不在 ontology 合法类型列表中\\n- EV (Event Vocabulary): event type 不在 ontology 定义中\\n- RoV (Role Vocabulary): argument role 不在该 event type 定义中\\n- AC (Argument Constraint): argument entity type 不满足 role→entity_type 约束（DR 的自然推广）\\n- CF (Cross-Field): 同一 entity 跨 event 被赋予不同 type\\n\\n**Expected evidence**:\\n- 3 models × unconstrained/constrained on WikiEvents → violation rate + F1\\n- Argument role type violation (AC) elimination rate\\n- Demonstration that zero-code ontology compilation works for event extraction\\n\\n**Story upgrade**: With WikiEvents results, paper narrative shifts from \\\"RE-specific constrained decoding\\\" to \\\"universal ontology-constrained structured generation framework applicable to any IE task with formal type constraints\\\". This is the key differentiator for conference main vs Findings.\\n\\n**Risk**:\\n- If WikiEvents violation rate is inherently low, constraint value demonstration is weak\\n- Event extraction JSON format is more complex than RE triples (nested events → arguments)\\n- Dataset size (~246 docs) relatively small\\n- Timeline tight (May 25 DDL)\\n\\n## Anticipated Reviewer Concerns\\n\\n### C1: \\\"5.78% is barely above 5% — threshold is arbitrary\\\"\\n**Response**: Don't argue about the threshold. Argue about per-relation distribution: Compare (27.6%), Evaluate-for (29.9%), Feature-of (11.3%) have double-digit violation rates with schema-informed prompt. The value proposition is per-relation guaranteed compliance, not overall statistical rate.\\n\\n### C2: \\\"Why not just post-hoc filter?\\\"\\n**Response (D013, 实验结果已出)**:\\n\\nPost-hoc filtering 实验结果：post-hoc F1 > OntoCoDec F1（SciERC 8.63 vs 8.36, DocRED 9.61 vs 8.24）——因 low F1 regime 下移除 FP 大幅提升 precision。\\n\\n**论文 framing（不以 F1 论高低，多维对比）**:\\n1. **Recall 维度（核心论点）**: OntoCoDec recall 上升 (SciERC +0.20pp, DocRED +0.56pp) = 概率质量重分配到合法 token 生效。Post-hoc recall 下降 (SciERC -0.72pp, DocRED -1.06pp) = 正确 triple 被误删。\\n2. **Information coverage**: DocRED post-hoc 丢弃 **48.1%** triples（近半数信息丢失），SciERC 16.8%。OntoCoDec 保留全部 triple slots。\\n3. **Operational**: OntoCoDec 产出即合规、无需后处理、支持流式。Post-hoc 需额外管线、不适用实时场景。\\n4. **Precision trade-off（诚实承认）**: \\\"Post-hoc achieves higher precision by removing a large fraction of triples, many of which are incorrect. This trades information coverage for precision — valid when FP are costly, but inadequate when completeness matters.\\\"\\n\\n数据表：SciERC post-hoc rejection 16.8%, OntoCoDec recall 11.60 vs post-hoc 10.68; DocRED post-hoc rejection 48.1%, OntoCoDec recall 10.02 vs post-hoc 8.40。\\n\\n**Reviewer 补充发现（D013 后）**:\\n5. **ET 残余**：post-hoc 只删 triples 不改 entity list，残余 ET=0.4% (SciERC) / 2.47% (DocRED)。OntoCoDec ET=0%。Post-hoc 无法解决 entity type 违规。\\n6. **127 个被删 TP (DocRED)**：过滤前 TP=1137，过滤后 TP=1010。丢失的 127 个 TP（11.2%）是正确提取但 entity type 违规的 triple。OntoCoDec 通过生成时强制合法 type 保留这些 TP——\\\"prevent vs detect\\\" 核心论据的具体数据。\\n7. **OntoCoDec+post-hoc 组合**（future work idea）：先 constrain 再 filter 残余 DR。低优先级，May 19 前不做。\\n\\n### C3: \\\"Bitwise AND of two masks is not novel\\\"\\n**Response**: The novelty is not the AND operation — it's (a) the automatic compilation from ontology definitions (zero-code schema compliance), (b) the stateful entity registry enabling cross-field constraints during autoregressive generation, (c) the decidability taxonomy providing theoretical guidance, and (d) the systematic violation landscape measurement motivating the approach.\\n\\n### C4: \\\"Evaluate-for violation rate increases with schema-informed prompt\\\"\\n**Response (prior-constraint conflict framework)**: Evaluate-for has 23/36 valid pairs; Method→Task is invalid for Evaluate-for but natural in the LLM's distributional prior (\\\"Method X evaluates for Task Y\\\" is semantically plausible). Schema-informed prompting creates a **prior-constraint conflict**: the model learns to avoid Method→Task for Evaluate-for (reducing count 133→87, -34.6%), but the remaining instances are harder boundary cases where the model's type assignment strategy becomes less stable. ## Target Venue
EMNLP 2026 (ARR submission May 25, 2026) — **目标: conference main**（D040, 用户明确指示）

## Title
OntoCoDec: Type-Valid Information Extraction via Compiled Ontology Constraints
(D015: "Near-Complete" dropped — DocRED residual DR=10.21% (Qwen) 不算 near-complete。论文贡献是方法，不是特定消除率。SciERC 0.93% 和 DocRED 2.55% (Llama) 可在正文中描述为 near-complete，但 title 不宜 overclaim。)

**D040 Story 升级方向**: 从 "IE-specific constrained decoding" → "universal ontology-constrained structured generation framework"。ACE05 Event Extraction 验证跨任务泛化。最终 title 待 ACE05 结果确认后调整（可能改为 "Ontology-Constrained Structured Generation" 或保持 IE 聚焦但扩展 scope）。

## Core Insight
LLM-based IE systems produce systematic ontology constraint violations concentrated in specific relation types. Prompt-level intervention (schema-informed prompting) reduces violations by ~62% but cannot eliminate them — certain relation types retain 25-30% violation rates even with explicit constraint descriptions. OntoCoDec provides **near-complete elimination (DR 15.4%→0.93%, ↓94%) at zero or positive F1 impact** through automatic ontology-to-decoder constraint compilation with two complementary layers.

**Phase 2 confirmed (D012 bootstrap CI, v2 fix)**: Grammar+Semantic dual-layer constrained decoding reduces domain/range violations by 94%, eliminates entity-type and relation-vocabulary violations entirely (→0%). F1 impact is **dataset-dependent**:
- SciERC: Rel F1 neutral (+0.13pp, p=0.58), Ent F1 neutral (-0.03pp, p=0.53)
- DocRED: Rel F1 **significantly improved** (+0.50pp, p<0.001, 95% CI [+0.23, +0.81]); Ent F1 **significantly improved** (+1.23pp, p<0.001, 95% CI [+0.94, +1.55])
- Mechanism: grammar 消除 OOV relation names (DocRED RV 29.66%→0.03%) + 非标 entity types (ET 2.48%→0%)。all_set F1 方法下 OOV=FP → fewer FP → higher precision/F1。SciERC baseline RV/ET 已很低，效果不显著。
- **Grammar 层是 F1 提升的唯一来源**: grammar_only Ent F1=59.38% ≈ full_s1 59.37% (Δ+0.01pp, p=0.66)。Semantic 层对 F1 无额外贡献，专注 DR reduction。

## Core Claims

### Claim 1 (Empirical): Violation Landscape
LLM-based IE systems violate ontology type constraints at non-trivial rates (15.4% per-triple on SciERC, 18.7% on DocRED). Violations are **not uniformly distributed** — they concentrate on relation types with tight domain/range constraints (Feature-of 33.5%, Compare 42.4%) while loose-constraint relations show near-zero violation (Used-for 0.8%).

**Key insight**: Violation rate is driven by **constraint tightness**, not ontology size. A small ontology with tight constraints can produce more violations than a large ontology with loose constraints.

**D014 修订**: DR reduction ceiling 由 **tightness × model RV baseline** 共同决定，非 tightness 单因素。Llama DocRED DR↓90.2% vs Qwen DR↓44.7%（同一 ontology τ̄=0.842）。机制：Qwen RV=29.66% >> Llama RV=16.03% → grammar 层将 OOV triples 强制匹配有效关系名 → 揭露大量 latent DR violations → 残余 DR 更高。这是比单一 tightness 更深的 insight。

**Evidence**: SciERC (7 relations) 15.4%; DocRED (96 relations) 18.7% — comparable rates despite 14× ontology size difference. Schema-informed prompt on DocRED only achieves DR↓32% (vs SciERC ↓62%), confirming **prompt-level intervention scales poorly with ontology complexity**.

### Claim 2 (Empirical): Prompt Insufficiency
Schema-informed prompting (explicitly describing domain/range constraints in the prompt) reduces but does not eliminate violations:
- Overall: 15.4% → 5.78% (-62.4%), still above 5%
- Per-relation: Compare 42.4% → 27.6%, Evaluate-for 24.1% → 29.9% (**worse**)
- Prompt intervention is unreliable at the per-relation level — some relations improve, one regresses

**Narrative**: This is NOT about "5.78% barely above 5%". The story is: **prompt-level intervention is fundamentally unreliable as a guarantee mechanism**. It works statistically but cannot provide per-instance compliance. Three specific relation types retain >10% violation rates with schema-informed prompts. For safety-critical IE (biomedical, legal, regulatory), statistical reduction is insufficient — guaranteed compliance is required.

### Claim 3 (Methodological): Composable Constraint Framework
OntoCoDec automatically compiles IE ontology schemas into two composable constraint layers:
1. **Grammar layer** (XGrammar): JSON structure + type vocabulary constraints (CFG-expressible)
2. **Semantic layer** (TypeConstraintProcessor): Cross-field domain/range constraints via stateful entity registry + dynamic logit masking

The two layers are **complementary with enabling dependency**: grammar ensures every generated relation type is in the valid vocabulary, which enables the semantic layer to look up and enforce domain/range rules for that type. Without grammar, the semantic layer encounters unknown relation types and cannot enforce constraints (explaining why semantic_only achieves only ↓24% vs full_s1 ↓94%). This is NOT "synergistic" (mutual amplification) — grammar is a prerequisite for semantic, not vice versa.

The two layers compose via bitwise AND of token masks. Recommended framing: "Grammar and semantic constraints compose via bitwise AND with an enabling dependency: grammar ensures structural validity, enabling semantic constraints to enforce domain/range rules. When constraint tightness creates empty intersection between layers, the system degrades gracefully to grammar-only constraints, maintaining structural validity as a guaranteed floor."

**Graceful degradation + Fallback 频率量化** (D008 + Reviewer 发现):
When $M_{semantic} \cap M_{grammar} = \emptyset$, the system falls back to grammar-only control.

**关键量化数据（Reviewer 从日志挖掘）**:
- Llama DocRED full_s1: **32,921 次 fallback / 577 docs = ~57 次/doc**
- Llama SciERC full_s1: **5,882 次 fallback / 550 docs = ~10.7 次/doc**
- DocRED fallback 频率是 SciERC 的 **5.3×**
- Qwen DocRED fallback 率未知（日志当时无 fallback logging，需估算）

**这直接解释了 DocRED DR 残余 10.19% vs SciERC 0.93%**: 更多 token 位置退化为 grammar-only → grammar-only 的 DR 已知为 26.17% → 高 fallback = 高残余 DR。

**论文建议**: 在 §5 tightness 段报告 fallback 率，定义 "Constraint Coverage" 指标（semantic masking 实际生效的 token 比例）。这把 "10.19% DR 残余" 从弱点变成可量化分析的 finding。Frame as "engineering robustness" in §4; fallback 频率 + tightness 作为 §5 定量分析。

**Decidability taxonomy**: Constraints classified by prefix-decidability:
- (a) Purely local: entity type ∈ vocabulary (grammar layer)
- (b) Prefix-decidable with state: relation argument types compatible with domain/range (semantic layer, requires entity registry)
- (c) Truly non-local: forward coreference — out of scope for forward-only decoding

### Claim 4 (Methodological): S1 vs S2 Decoding Strategies — Architectural Ablation
- S1 (single-pass): Both layers applied throughout generation. **Recommended primary strategy** — simpler, slightly better metrics across the board.
- S2 (two-pass): Pass 1 extracts entities (grammar-only), Pass 2 generates relations with input-dependent grammar compiled from Pass 1 entities.

**S2 full results (551/551 SciERC)**: DR 0.97% (vs S1 0.93%), CF 8.03% (vs S1 9.9%), R-F1 8.03% (vs S1 8.36%). S2 does NOT solve CF — the 1.87pp reduction is not significant. S2 also slightly worse on DR and F1. **S2 is an architectural variant demonstrating framework flexibility, not a CF solution.** Position in paper as ablation (Section 5 or Appendix), not as a core contribution.

⚠️ **Do NOT cite pilot50 DR=0% as S2 evidence** — small-sample artifact; full run shows DR=0.97%. Per-relation S2 DR is worse than S1 on Compare (4.6% vs 2.82%), Part-of (1.25% vs 0%), Used-for (0.12% vs 0%).

### Claim 5 (Empirical): Cross-Task Generalization — Event Extraction (D040, NEW)
**Status**: 🔄 In progress (Agent implementing WikiEvents pipeline)

OntoCoDec generalizes beyond Relation Extraction to **Event Extraction** (WikiEvents, Li et al. NAACL 2021), demonstrating that the framework is task-agnostic for any IE task with ontology-defined type constraints.

**WikiEvents specifics** (DARPA KAIROS ontology):
- 51 event types × 80 argument roles × 26 entity types
- 226 组显式 (event_type, role) → allowed_entity_types 约束，从 `event_role_KAIROS.json` 的 `role_types` 字段直接获取
- Maps directly to OntoCoDec's semantic layer: argument role type constraints ≡ domain/range constraints
- 26 entity types（比 ACE05 的 7 个更丰富）→ constraint space 更大，更能展示 semantic layer 价值
- 99.98% 数据满足约束 → 约束定义是真实有效的

**数据集选择理由**（MAVEN/RAMS 排除）：
- MAVEN (168 types): 无 argument extraction，不适用
- MAVEN-Arg (162 types): FrameNet-based，无 role→entity_type schema 约束
- RAMS (139 types): 仅 cardinality 约束，无 entity type binding
- ACE05 (33 types): LDC 付费，采购周期来不及
- **WikiEvents 是唯一同时满足 "免费 + 有显式 role→entity_type 约束" 的数据集**

**Violation 分类** (5 类，从 RE 的 4 类扩展):
- ET (Entity Type): entity type 不在 ontology 合法类型列表中
- EV (Event Vocabulary): event type 不在 ontology 定义中
- RoV (Role Vocabulary): argument role 不在该 event type 定义中
- AC (Argument Constraint): argument entity type 不满足 role→entity_type 约束（DR 的自然推广）
- CF (Cross-Field): 同一 entity 跨 event 被赋予不同 type

**Expected evidence**:
- 3 models × unconstrained/constrained on WikiEvents → violation rate + F1
- Argument role type violation (AC) elimination rate
- Demonstration that zero-code ontology compilation works for event extraction

**Story upgrade**: With WikiEvents results, paper narrative shifts from "RE-specific constrained decoding" to "universal ontology-constrained structured generation framework applicable to any IE task with formal type constraints". This is the key differentiator for conference main vs Findings.

**Risk**:
- If WikiEvents violation rate is inherently low, constraint value demonstration is weak
- Event extraction JSON format is more complex than RE triples (nested events → arguments)
- Dataset size (~246 docs) relatively small
- Timeline tight (May 25 DDL)

## Anticipated Reviewer Concerns

### C1: "5.78% is barely above 5% — threshold is arbitrary"
**Response**: Don't argue about the threshold. Argue about per-relation distribution: Compare (27.6%), Evaluate-for (29.9%), Feature-of (11.3%) have double-digit violation rates with schema-informed prompt. The value proposition is per-relation guaranteed compliance, not overall statistical rate.

### C2: "Why not just post-hoc filter?"
**Response (D013, 实验结果已出)**:

Post-hoc filtering 实验结果：post-hoc F1 > OntoCoDec F1（SciERC 8.63 vs 8.36, DocRED 9.61 vs 8.24）——因 low F1 regime 下移除 FP 大幅提升 precision。

**论文 framing（不以 F1 论高低，多维对比）**:
1. **Recall 维度（核心论点）**: OntoCoDec recall 上升 (SciERC +0.20pp, DocRED +0.56pp) = 概率质量重分配到合法 token 生效。Post-hoc recall 下降 (SciERC -0.72pp, DocRED -1.06pp) = 正确 triple 被误删。
2. **Information coverage**: DocRED post-hoc 丢弃 **48.1%** triples（近半数信息丢失），SciERC 16.8%。OntoCoDec 保留全部 triple slots。
3. **Operational**: OntoCoDec 产出即合规、无需后处理、支持流式。Post-hoc 需额外管线、不适用实时场景。
4. **Precision trade-off（诚实承认）**: "Post-hoc achieves higher precision by removing a large fraction of triples, many of which are incorrect. This trades information coverage for precision — valid when FP are costly, but inadequate when completeness matters."

数据表：SciERC post-hoc rejection 16.8%, OntoCoDec recall 11.60 vs post-hoc 10.68; DocRED post-hoc rejection 48.1%, OntoCoDec recall 10.02 vs post-hoc 8.40。

**Reviewer 补充发现（D013 后）**:
5. **ET 残余**：post-hoc 只删 triples 不改 entity list，残余 ET=0.4% (SciERC) / 2.47% (DocRED)。OntoCoDec ET=0%。Post-hoc 无法解决 entity type 违规。
6. **127 个被删 TP (DocRED)**：过滤前 TP=1137，过滤后 TP=1010。丢失的 127 个 TP（11.2%）是正确提取但 entity type 违规的 triple。OntoCoDec 通过生成时强制合法 type 保留这些 TP——"prevent vs detect" 核心论据的具体数据。
7. **OntoCoDec+post-hoc 组合**（future work idea）：先 constrain 再 filter 残余 DR。低优先级，May 19 前不做。

### C3: "Bitwise AND of two masks is not novel"
**Response**: The novelty is not the AND operation — it's (a) the automatic compilation from ontology definitions (zero-code schema compliance), (b) the stateful entity registry enabling cross-field constraints during autoregressive generation, (c) the decidability taxonomy providing theoretical guidance, and (d) the systematic violation landscape measurement motivating the approach.

### C4: "Evaluate-for violation rate increases with schema-informed prompt"
**Response (prior-constraint conflict framework)**: Evaluate-for has 23/36 valid pairs; Method→Task is invalid for Evaluate-for but natural in the LLM's distributional prior ("Method X evaluates for Task Y" is semantically plausible). Schema-informed prompting creates a **prior-constraint conflict**: the model learns to avoid Method→Task for Evaluate-for (reducing count 133→87, -34.6%), but the remaining instances are harder boundary cases where the model's type assignment strategy becomes less stable. This is not just "harder instances" — it's an active interference between prompt-level constraint signals and the model's learned type associations.

**This strengthens the paper's claim**: prompt-level intervention is not merely insufficient but potentially **counterproductive** for specific constraint configurations. Decoding-time enforcement avoids this issue entirely — it operates on logits, not on the model's reasoning process, so there is no prior-constraint conflict.

### C5: "Only tested on one model (Qwen3-8B)"
**Response**: Cross-model validation DONE (D016 bootstrap verified). Llama-3.1-8B 零代码修改：
- SciERC: DR 13.34%→0.08% (↓99.4%), R-F1 -0.14pp (p=0.011, negligible), E-F1 NS
- DocRED: DR 26.07%→2.55% (↓90.2%), R-F1 +0.29pp (p=0.013, significant), E-F1 -0.64pp (p=0.022, modest decline)
- Parse failures: unconstrained 68 vs full_s1 91 (6.8% vs 9.1%)

**Cross-model claim 指导（Reviewer 专项评估）**:
- ✅ 可声明："OntoCoDec generalizes across model families without code modification"（程序性事实，铁证）
- ❌ 不可声明："consistently achieves the same reduction rate"（仅 2 模型，不足以量化声明）
- **RV↓DR↑ 正交性 finding**: Llama RV baseline 低(16%) 但 DR baseline 高(26%)，反向于 Qwen。证明两层约束解决正交 failure modes——vocabulary compliance ≠ semantic compliance。应作为 §5 cross-model 独立 finding 展开。
- **Parse failure 偏差**: checker skip parse failures (不计入 F1)，Llama 68/998=6.8% vs Qwen 12/998=1.2%。偏差方向保守（不利于 constrained），不威胁 claim。但需 footnote 披露 + cross-model 表增加 parse failure rate 行。
- **Llama SciERC CF=6.56%**: 比 Qwen 同量级更高，non-local constraint 问题在 Llama 上更突出，limitations 提及。
- 等 llama_docred_full_s1 出来后定最终 claim 措辞。

### C6: "Constrained decoding degrades generation quality (CRANE, Structure Snowballing)"
**Response**: OntoCoDec's semantic constraints are narrower than full grammar constraints — only type tokens are masked, free text is unconstrained. **Bootstrap CI (10000×, D012 Qwen + D016 Llama, all registry-aligned)**:

**Qwen3-8B**: SciERC R-F1 +0.13pp (p=0.58, NS), E-F1 -0.03pp (NS). DocRED R-F1 +0.50pp (p<0.001), E-F1 +1.23pp (p<0.001).
**Llama-3.1-8B**: SciERC R-F1 -0.14pp (p=0.011, negligible), E-F1 NS. DocRED R-F1 +0.29pp (p=0.013), E-F1 -0.64pp (p=0.022).

**Cross-model pattern**: DocRED R-F1 显著提升（两个模型）。E-F1 model-dependent（Qwen +1.23pp, Llama -0.64pp）。
- 机制：grammar 消除 OOV relation names + 非标 entity types → all_set 方法下减少 FP → precision 提升。Grammar 是 F1 提升的唯一来源（grammar_only Ent F1=59.38% ≈ full_s1 59.37%, Δ=0.01pp, p=0.66）。Semantic 层对 F1 无额外贡献。
- Frame as: "On DocRED, R-F1 gains are significant for both models. Entity F1 impact is model-dependent."
- 不升级为 core claim，但如实报告。

### C7: "Your method trades DR violations for CF violations (cross-field consistency)"
**Response**: Both S1 and S2 show elevated CF (per-triple rate ~8-10%). This is an inherent limitation of per-relation independent type enforcement. Must be proactively reported as a limitation. Defense:

**CF 子类型分析（根因已确认）**：
- **EVR（entity-vs-relation type drift）**: 占 CF 的 >90%。同一 entity 在 entity list 和 relation triple 中被赋予不同 type。S1: 245 entities (7.34%), S2: 178 entities (5.54%, -27%)
- **Within-rel（同 entity 跨 relation type 不一致）**: S1: 10 (0.36%), S2: 18 (0.72%)
- S2 减少 EVR 但增加 within-rel——trade-off 更复杂，不是单纯好/差

**Top 冲突模式**: Generic↔OtherScientificTerm (60次), Material↔OtherScientificTerm (28次), Material↔Method (20次)。**这些是 SciERC type system 固有的语义边界模糊区**——同一术语在不同学术语境下确实可以被合理归类为不同 type。CF 在相当程度上是 type system 模糊性的体现，非纯粹的方法缺陷。

**论证层次**：
1. DR violations = structurally invalid triples（下游系统不可用）→ hard constraint
2. CF violations = same entity gets different types across relations → individual triples remain type-valid, only cross-triple consistency broken → soft preference
3. CF 的根因是 type system 语义边界模糊 + per-relation 独立 enforcement，非 bug
4. Future work: cross-relation global consistency pass (entity-level type consensus before relation-specific enforcement)

**机制归因（口径对账确认）**：grammar_only CF=0.08%（与 unconstrained 持平），full_s1 CF=9.90%，full_s2 CF=8.03%。**CF 100% 由 semantic 层引入，grammar 层无贡献。** 这为 "CF 是 semantic type enforcement 的系统性副作用" 提供干净的消融证据。

**论文数字口径**：CF rate 用 violation_checker 口径（denominator=total_entities，与 DR/RV/ET 一致）。分析段落额外给 entity-level EVR 率 + 受影响样本比例。注意：analyze_cf 脚本的 EVR/WR 两维度不是独立的（WR⊂EVR），论文中不要作为两个独立维度报告。

**Do NOT hide this data.** Proactive disclosure + severity distinction + root cause analysis + type ambiguity evidence + 消融归因 = 最强防御策略。

### C8: "Absolute F1 is too low (~8%) — results are not meaningful"
**Response**: This is a zero-shot extraction setting (no training data, no fine-tuning). Low F1 is expected — supervised SOTA on SciERC relation F1 is ~40-50%. Our contribution is the constraint enforcement method, not extraction quality. F1 is a control variable verifying constraints don't degrade quality, not an optimization target. Recommended framing: "We evaluate in a zero-shot setting to demonstrate that our constraint enforcement method works without task-specific training. F1 is reported to verify that constraint enforcement does not degrade extraction quality, not as a claim of state-of-the-art performance."

## Paper Structure (Draft — D040 updated)
1. Introduction: Ontology constraint violations in LLM-based structured generation + composable framework overview (story: not just RE, general ontology-constrained generation)
2. Background: Grammar-constrained decoding (XGrammar) + IE ontology structure
3. Violation Landscape Study (Phase 0 empirics — independent contribution)
4. OntoCoDec Framework: Compiler + TypeConstraintProcessor + S1/S2 strategies
5. Experiments:
   - §5.1-5.3: RE experiments (SciERC + DocRED, 3 models, constrained vs unconstrained vs post-hoc vs prompt-based)
   - §5.4: **Event Extraction (ACE05)** — cross-task generalization (NEW, D040)
   - §5.5: Ablation + analysis (composability, latency, beam search, etc.)
6. Related Work: 5 constraint paradigms (grammar, vocabulary, structural, type-checking, ontology) + event extraction methods
7. Conclusion: Framework generality across IE tasks

## Claim Calibration (per Reviewer assessment)

**Safe to claim (sufficient evidence from Phase 2)**:
- "First systematic study of ontology constraint violations in LLM-based IE"
- "Violation rate correlates with constraint tightness, not ontology size" (D014: DR reduction ceiling 由 tightness × model RV baseline 共同决定)
- "Grammar+semantic constrained decoding eliminates 94% of DR violations at zero F1 cost" ✅ Phase 2 confirmed
- "Two-layer architecture provides complementary coverage — grammar enables semantic" ✅ Ablation confirmed
- "Prompt-level intervention scales poorly with ontology complexity" ✅ SciERC ↓62% vs DocRED ↓32%

**Claim with caution**:
- "Near-complete type-valid IE" — S1 0.93%, S2 0.97% residual, not truly 0%. Title updated to "Near-Complete"
- "Principled framework applicable to arbitrary IE ontologies" — validated on 2 datasets + 1 model only
- "F1 improvement" — SciERC: not significant (p=0.58), frame as F1-neutral; DocRED: significant (+0.50pp, p<0.001), 可报告但不升级为 core claim，归因于 OOV elimination 而非约束解码本身的提升
- "CF reveals type system ambiguity" — 可在 §5.3 作为 analysis finding 展开（Generic↔OtherScientificTerm 等模式有独立 insight 价值），但 §7 必须同时保留 CF 作为 limitation + future work。**两处都要有，缺一不可。** 不能暗示"因为是 type ambiguity 所以 CF 可接受"

**Do NOT claim**:
- "General infrastructure for IE" — only zero-shot extraction validated
- "State-of-the-art" — F1 is control variable, not optimization target (see C8)
- "Synergistic effect" — mechanism is enabling dependency, not mutual amplification (see Claim 3)
- "S2 solves CF" or "S2 mitigates Structure Snowballing" — data shows S2 ≈ S1 on all metrics; position as architectural variant only
- "Pilot50 DR=0%" — small-sample artifact, full S2 has DR=0.97%
- "Grammar-first invariant" 作为独立 claim — 证据不足（仅 1 次崩溃触发，实现是 fallback 非形式化保证）。写入 §4 方法论设计原则（1-2 句），不升级为 claim
- "Robust dual-layer composition across schema complexities" — 等 DocRED 完成。最终如 fallback ≤5/998，可写经验性陈述，不做泛化 claim

## Risk Ranking (ordered by reject probability)

1. **CF violation trade-off under-addressed** (MEDIUM-HIGH): S1 9.9%, S2 8.03% — both elevated. **S2 confirmed: does NOT solve CF.** This is the #1 attack surface. Mitigated by proactive disclosure + severity distinction + root cause analysis (C7). Must be reported as explicit limitation with future work direction (global entity-type consensus).
2. ~~**Single model limitation**~~ (RESOLVED): Llama-3.1-8B SciERC ✅ (DR↓99.4%) + DocRED ✅ (DR↓90.2%). 2 模型 × 2 数据集全矩阵完成。
3. **Novelty perception** (MEDIUM): "PLDI'25 for code → OntoCoDec for IE" attack line. Must argue IE constraint structure differs fundamentally.
4. ~~**DocRED Phase 2 weak**~~ (RESOLVED → reframed as D014): Qwen DR↓44.7%, Llama DR↓90.2% — both substantial. Weaker Qwen reduction explained by RV baseline interaction (D014), not method failure.
5. ~~**Phase 2 F1 drop**~~ (RESOLVED): F1 confirmed neutral (SciERC) or positive (DocRED, p<0.001). Bootstrap CI D012 confirms. No longer a risk.

## Critical Path to EMNLP Submission (May 25)

- **May 13-14**: Phase 0 + Phase 1 + Phase 2 SciERC ✅
- **May 14**: Phase 2 DocRED 4-way ablation ✅ + Llama SciERC cross-model ✅ + Dream 完成 (3/6)

- **May 19**: 内部稿 → submit_paper_to_review
- **May 19-24**: Review 修改 + 最终提交

**当前瓶颈**: 无技术 blocker。等 Reviewer 跨文件一致性审查 + 编译验证后即可 submit_paper_to_review。

1	# OntoCoDec — Paper Framing
2	
3	## Target Venue
4	EMNLP 2026 (ARR submission May 25, 2026) — **目标: conference main**（D040, 用户明确指示）
5	
6	## Title
7	OntoCoDec: Type-Valid Information Extraction via Compiled Ontology Constraints
8	(D015: "Near-Complete" dropped — DocRED residual DR=10.21% (Qwen) 不算 near-complete。论文贡献是方法，不是特定消除率。SciERC 0.93% 和 DocRED 2.55% (Llama) 可在正文中描述为 near-complete，但 title 不宜 overclaim。)
9	
10	**D040 Story 升级方向**: 从 "IE-specific constrained decoding" → "universal ontology-constrained structured generation framework"。ACE05 Event Extraction 验证跨任务泛化。最终 title 待 ACE05 结果确认后调整（可能改为 "Ontology-Constrained Structured Generation" 或保持 IE 聚焦但扩展 scope）。
11	
12	## Core Insight
13	LLM-based IE systems produce systematic ontology constraint violations concentrated in specific relation types. Prompt-level intervention (schema-informed prompting) reduces violations by ~62% but cannot eliminate them — certain relation types retain 25-30% violation rates even with explicit constraint descriptions. OntoCoDec provides **near-complete elimination (DR 15.4%→0.93%, ↓94%) at zero or positive F1 impact** through automatic ontology-to-decoder constraint compilation with two complementary layers.
14	
15	**Phase 2 confirmed (D012 bootstrap CI, v2 fix)**: Grammar+Semantic dual-layer constrained decoding reduces domain/range violations by 94%, eliminates entity-type and relation-vocabulary violations entirely (→0%). F1 impact is **dataset-dependent**:
16	- SciERC: Rel F1 neutral (+0.13pp, p=0.58), Ent F1 neutral (-0.03pp, p=0.53)
17	- DocRED: Rel F1 **significantly improved** (+0.50pp, p<0.001, 95% CI [+0.23, +0.81]); Ent F1 **significantly improved** (+1.23pp, p<0.001, 95% CI [+0.94, +1.55])
18	- Mechanism: grammar 消除 OOV relation names (DocRED RV 29.66%→0.03%) + 非标 entity types (ET 2.48%→0%)。all_set F1 方法下 OOV=FP → fewer FP → higher precision/F1。SciERC baseline RV/ET 已很低，效果不显著。
19	- **Grammar 层是 F1 提升的唯一来源**: grammar_only Ent F1=59.38% ≈ full_s1 59.37% (Δ+0.01pp, p=0.66)。Semantic 层对 F1 无额外贡献，专注 DR reduction。
20	
21	## Core Claims
22	
23	### Claim 1 (Empirical): Violation Landscape
24	LLM-based IE systems violate ontology type constraints at non-trivial rates (15.4% per-triple on SciERC, 18.7% on DocRED). Violations are **not uniformly distributed** — they concentrate on relation types with tight domain/range constraints (Feature-of 33.5%, Compare 42.4%) while loose-constraint relations show near-zero violation (Used-for 0.8%).
25	
26	**Key insight**: Violation rate is driven by **constraint tightness**, not ontology size. A small ontology with tight constraints can produce more violations than a large ontology with loose constraints.
27	
28	**D014 修订**: DR reduction ceiling 由 **tightness × model RV baseline** 共同决定，非 tightness 单因素。Llama DocRED DR↓90.2% vs Qwen DR↓44.7%（同一 ontology τ̄=0.842）。机制：Qwen RV=29.66% >> Llama RV=16.03% → grammar 层将 OOV triples 强制匹配有效关系名 → 揭露大量 latent DR violations → 残余 DR 更高。这是比单一 tightness 更深的 insight。
29	
30	**Evidence**: SciERC (7 relations) 15.4%; DocRED (96 relations) 18.7% — comparable rates despite 14× ontology size difference. Schema-informed prompt on DocRED only achieves DR↓32% (vs SciERC ↓62%), confirming **prompt-level intervention scales poorly with ontology complexity**.
31	
32	### Claim 2 (Empirical): Prompt Insufficiency
33	Schema-informed prompting (explicitly describing domain/range constraints in the prompt) reduces but does not eliminate violations:
34	- Overall: 15.4% → 5.78% (-62.4%), still above 5%
35	- Per-relation: Compare 42.4% → 27.6%, Evaluate-for 24.1% → 29.9% (**worse**)

# OntoCoDec — Paper Framing

## Target Venue
EMNLP 2026 (ARR submission May 25, 2026) — **目标: conference main**（D040, 用户明确指示）

## Title
OntoCoDec: Type-Valid Information Extraction via Compiled Ontology Constraints
(D015: "Near-Complete" dropped — DocRED residual DR=10.21% (Qwen) 不算 near-complete。论文贡献是方法，不是特定消除率。SciERC 0.93% 和 DocRED 2.55% (Llama) 可在正文中描述为 near-complete，但 title 不宜 overclaim。)

**D040 Story 升级方向**: 从 "IE-specific constrained decoding" → "universal ontology-constrained structured generation framework"。ACE05 Event Extraction 验证跨任务泛化。最终 title 待 ACE05 结果确认后调整（可能改为 "Ontology-Constrained Structured Generation" 或保持 IE 聚焦但扩展 scope）。

## Core Insight
LLM-based IE systems produce systematic ontology constraint violations concentrated in specific relation types. Prompt-level intervention (schema-informed prompting) reduces violations by ~62% but cannot eliminate them — certain relation types retain 25-30% violation rates even with explicit constraint descriptions. OntoCoDec provides **near-complete elimination (DR 15.4%→0.93%, ↓94%) at zero or positive F1 impact** through automatic ontology-to-decoder constraint compilation with two complementary layers.

**Phase 2 confirmed (D012 bootstrap CI, v2 fix)**: Grammar+Semantic dual-layer constrained decoding reduces domain/range violations by 94%, eliminates entity-type and relation-vocabulary violations entirely (→0%). F1 impact is **dataset-dependent**:
- SciERC: Rel F1 neutral (+0.13pp, p=0.58), Ent F1 neutral (-0.03pp, p=0.53)
- DocRED: Rel F1 **significantly improved** (+0.50pp, p<0.001, 95% CI [+0.23, +0.81]); Ent F1 **significantly improved** (+1.23pp, p<0.001, 95% CI [+0.94, +1.55])
- Mechanism: grammar 消除 OOV relation names (DocRED RV 29.66%→0.03%) + 非标 entity types (ET 2.48%→0%)。all_set F1 方法下 OOV=FP → fewer FP → higher precision/F1。SciERC baseline RV/ET 已很低，效果不显著。
- **Grammar 层是 F1 提升的唯一来源**: grammar_only Ent F1=59.38% ≈ full_s1 59.37% (Δ+0.01pp, p=0.66)。Semantic 层对 F1 无额外贡献，专注 DR reduction。

## Core Claims

### Claim 1 (Empirical): Violation Landscape
LLM-based IE systems violate ontology type constraints at non-trivial rates (15.4% per-triple on SciERC, 18.7% on DocRED). Violations are **not uniformly distributed** — they concentrate on relation types with tight domain/range constraints (Feature-of 33.5%, Compare 42.4%) while loose-constraint relations show near-zero violation (Used-for 0.8%).

**Key insight**: Violation rate is driven by **constraint tightness**, not ontology size. A small ontology with tight constraints can produce more violations than a large ontology with loose constraints.

**D014 修订**: DR reduction ceiling 由 **tightness × model RV baseline** 共同决定，非 tightness 单因素。Llama DocRED DR↓90.2% vs Qwen DR↓44.7%（同一 ontology τ̄=0.842）。机制：Qwen RV=29.66% >> Llama RV=16.03% → grammar 层将 OOV triples 强制匹配有效关系名 → 揭露大量 latent DR violations → 残余 DR 更高。这是比单一 tightness 更深的 insight。

**Evidence**: SciERC (7 relations) 15.4%; DocRED (96 relations) 18.7% — comparable rates despite 14× ontology size difference. Schema-informed prompt on DocRED only achieves DR↓32% (vs SciERC ↓62%), confirming **prompt-level intervention scales poorly with ontology complexity**.

### Claim 2 (Empirical): Prompt Insufficiency
Schema-informed prompting (explicitly describing domain/range constraints in the prompt) reduces but does not eliminate violations:
- Overall: 15.4% → 5.78% (-62.4%), still above 5%
- Per-relation: Compare 42.4% → 27.6%, Evaluate-for 24.1% → 29.9% (**worse**)
- Prompt intervention is unreliable at the per-relation level — some relations improve, one regresses

**Narrative**: This is NOT about "5.78% barely above 5%". The story is: **prompt-level intervention is fundamentally unreliable as a guarantee mechanism**. It works statistically but cannot provide per-instance compliance. Three specific relation types retain >10% violation rates with schema-informed prompts. For safety-critical IE (biomedical, legal, regulatory), statistical reduction is insufficient — guaranteed compliance is required.

### Claim 3 (Methodological): Composable Constraint Framework
OntoCoDec automatically compiles IE ontology schemas into two composable constraint layers:
1. **Grammar layer** (XGrammar): JSON structure + type vocabulary constraints (CFG-expressible)
2. **Semantic layer** (TypeConstraintProcessor): Cross-field domain/range constraints via stateful entity registry + dynamic logit masking

The two layers are **complementary with enabling dependency**: grammar ensures every generated relation type is in the valid vocabulary, which enables the semantic layer to look up and enforce domain/range rules for that type. Without grammar, the semantic layer encounters unknown relation types and cannot enforce constraints (explaining why semantic_only achieves only ↓24% vs full_s1 ↓94%). This is NOT "synergistic" (mutual amplification) — grammar is a prerequisite for semantic, not vice versa.

The two layers compose via bitwise AND of token masks. Recommended framing: "Grammar and semantic constraints compose via bitwise AND with an enabling dependency: grammar ensures structural validity, enabling semantic constraints to enforce domain/range rules. When constraint tightness creates empty intersection between layers, the system degrades gracefully to grammar-only constraints, maintaining structural validity as a guaranteed floor."

**Graceful degradation + Fallback 频率量化** (D008 + Reviewer 发现):
When $M_{semantic} \cap M_{grammar} = \emptyset$, the system falls back to grammar-only control.

## Paper Structure (Draft — D040 updated)
1. Introduction: Ontology constraint violations in LLM-based structured generation + composable framework overview (story: not just RE, general ontology-constrained generation)
2. Background: Grammar-constrained decoding (XGrammar) + IE ontology structure
3. Violation Landscape Study (Phase 0 empirics — independent contribution)
4. OntoCoDec Framework: Compiler + TypeConstraintProcessor + S1/S2 strategies
5. Experiments:
   - §5.1-5.3: RE experiments (SciERC + DocRED, 3 models, constrained vs unconstrained vs post-hoc vs prompt-based)
   - §5.4: **Event Extraction (ACE05)** — cross-task generalization (NEW, D040)
   - §5.5: Ablation + analysis (composability, latency, beam search, etc.)
6. Related Work: 5 constraint paradigms (grammar, vocabulary, structural, type-checking, ontology) + event extraction methods
7. Conclusion: Framework generality across IE tasks

## Claim Calibration (per Reviewer assessment)

**Safe to claim (sufficient evidence from Phase 2)**:
- "First systematic study of ontology constraint violations in LLM-based IE"
- "Violation rate correlates with constraint tightness, not ontology size" (D014: DR reduction ceiling 由 tightness × model RV baseline 共同决定)
- "Grammar+semantic constrained decoding eliminates 94% of DR violations at zero F1 cost" ✅ Phase 2 confirmed
- "Two-layer architecture provides complementary coverage — grammar enables semantic" ✅ Ablation confirmed
- "Prompt-level intervention scales poorly with ontology complexity" ✅ SciERC ↓62% vs DocRED ↓32%

**Claim with caution**:
- "Near-complete type-valid IE" — S1 0.93%, S2 0.97% residual, not truly 0%. Title updated to "Near-Complete"
- "Principled framework applicable to arbitrary IE ontologies" — validated on 2 datasets + 1 model only
- "F1 improvement" — SciERC: not significant (p=0.58), frame as F1-neutral; DocRED: significant (+0.50pp, p<0.001), 可报告但不升级为 core claim，归因于 OOV elimination 而非约束解码本身的提升
- "CF reveals type system ambiguity" — 可在 §5.3 作为 analysis finding 展开（Generic↔OtherScientificTerm 等模式有独立 insight 价值），但 §7 必须同时保留 CF 作为 limitation + future work。**两处都要有，缺一不可。** 不能暗示"因为是 type ambiguity 所以 CF 可接受"

**Do NOT claim**:
- "General infrastructure for IE" — only zero-shot extraction validated
- "State-of-the-art" — F1 is control variable, not optimization target (see C8)
- "Synergistic effect" — mechanism is enabling dependency, not mutual amplification (see Claim 3)
- "S2 solves CF" or "S2 mitigates Structure Snowballing" — data shows S2 ≈ S1 on all metrics; position as architectural variant only
- "Pilot50 DR=0%" — small-sample artifact, full S2 has DR=0.97%
- "Grammar-first invariant" 作为独立 claim — 证据不足（仅 1 次崩溃触发，实现是 fallback 非形式化保证）。写入 §4 方法论设计原则（1-2 句），不升级为 claim
- "Robust dual-layer composition across schema complexities" — 等 DocRED 完成。最终如 fallback ≤5/998，可写经验性陈述，不做泛化 claim

## Risk Ranking (ordered by reject probability)

1. **CF violation trade-off under-addressed** (MEDIUM-HIGH): S1 9.9%, S2 8.03% — both elevated. **S2 confirmed: does NOT solve CF.** This is the #1 attack surface. Mitigated by proactive disclosure + severity distinction + root cause analysis (C7). Must be reported as explicit limitation with future work direction (global entity-type consensus).
2. ~~**Single model limitation**~~ (RESOLVED): Llama-3.1-8B SciERC ✅ (DR↓99.4%) + DocRED ✅ (DR↓90.2%). 2 模型 × 2 数据集全矩阵完成。
3. **Novelty perception** (MEDIUM): "PLDI'25 for code → OntoCoDec for IE" attack line. Must argue IE constraint structure differs fundamentally.
4. ~~**DocRED Phase 2 weak**~~ (RESOLVED → reframed as D014): Qwen DR↓44.7%, Llama DR↓90.2% — both substantial. Weaker Qwen reduction explained by RV baseline interaction (D014), not method failure.
5. ~~**Phase 2 F1 drop**~~ (RESOLVED): F1 confirmed neutral (SciERC) or positive (DocRED, p<0.001). Bootstrap CI D012 confirms. No longer a risk.
